Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.

The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim.
